content_sections.heading: RRB CEN 05/2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 590 vacancies across 9 posts, spread over all RRB zones. RRB-wise and Railway Zone-wise distribution is provided in Annexure-B of the official notification and is not reproduced here in full — the post-wise combined totals are as follows. RRB-wise and Railway Zone-wise vacancy numbers, along with PwBD (VI/LD/HI/MD) and Ex-Servicemen backlog vacancies, are given in Annexure-B of the detailed CEN. Vacancies indicated are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the requirement of Railway administrations concerned.

content_sections.heading: RRB CEN 05/2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must already possess the prescribed educational/technical/professional qualification from a recognised Institute/University as on the closing date, 14.10.2026. Candidates awaiting final results are NOT eligible to apply. Open and Distance Learning (ODL) qualifications from UGC-recognised Universities/Institutions of National Importance are accepted for ECG Technician and Lab Assistant Gr. II posts, subject to UGC approval.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: Registered Nurse and Midwife certificate (3-year course in General Nursing and Midwifery from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institution) OR B.Sc. Nursing
B.Sc. plus Diploma in Haemodialysis, or 2 years' satisfactory in-house training/experience in Haemodialysis work (B.Sc. in Dialysis Techniques/Technology/Renal Dialysis Technology also eligible)
B.Sc. with Chemistry as a subject, plus 1-year Diploma in Health/Sanitary Inspector OR 1-year NTC in Health Sanitary Inspector (NCVT)
Bachelor in Audiology, Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) from a recognised University, registered with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)
Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy (Allopathic) or Doctor of Pharmacy from a recognised University/Institute, registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948

10+2 with Physics and Chemistry plus Diploma in Radiography/X-Ray Technician/Radiodiagnosis Technology (2-year course); Science graduates with the same diploma preferred (various equivalent B.Sc. Radiography/Imaging qualifications also eligible)
10+2/Graduation in Science with Certificate/Diploma/Degree in ECG Laboratory Technology/Cardiology/Cardiology Technician/Techniques (minimum 1-year duration)
B.Sc. in Optometry or Diploma in Ophthalmic Technician (3–4 year course), with registration from the concerned Council/Licensing body
12th (10+2) in Science plus Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) or an equivalent Certificate Course (minimum 1-year, full-time) (B.Sc. Medical Lab Technology also eligible)

content_sections.heading: RRB CEN 05/2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection consists of a Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by Document Verification (DV) and a Medical Examination. The CBT is of 90 minutes' duration for 100 questions (120 minutes for PwBD/PWD candidates eligible for the Scribe facility), with objective multiple-choice questions (4 options, 1 correct answer). There is negative marking of 1/3 mark for every wrong answer. The subject/section-wise distribution is indicative and may vary. CBT questions are available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional Indian languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu). These percentages also apply to Ex-Servicemen and PwBD candidates as per their community, and may be relaxed by 2 marks for PwBD candidates in case of a shortage against reserved vacancies. Shortlisting for Document Verification will be done RRB-wise at the rate of 1:1 of vacancies, strictly on CBT merit. In case of a tie, the older candidate is ranked higher; if age is also the same, alphabetical order of the given name is used. Final empanelment is based on CBT merit, subject to successful Document Verification and passing the prescribed Medical Examination. RRBs only recommend empanelled candidates — the appointment offer is issued by the respective Railway Administration.

Capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile front camera as prompted (no pre-existing photo upload); wear non-white/dark clothing, no cap, mask or glasses. Upload your scanned signature and other mandatory documents as specified in the application. Choose your medium of examination from the available language options. Submit the application and proceed to pay the examination fee online (net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI) — acceptance of the application is final only after fee payment confirmation. Complete submission before 14.10.2026 (23:59 hrs), and complete fee payment by 16.10.2026. Use the modification window (17.10.2026 to 26.10.2026, with a ₹250 fee per correction) if any details (other than "Create an Account" data and chosen RRB) need correction. Multiple applications to different RRBs, or the same RRB, will result in rejection of all applications and may lead to disqualification and debarment from the recruitment process and future RRB/RRC examinations.

faq.question: Q1. What is RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: It is a Centralised Employment Notification issued by the Railway Recruitment Boards for the recruitment of various Paramedical categories, covering 9 posts and 590 vacancies across all RRB zones.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: There are 590 total vacancies: Nursing Superintendent (365), Pharmacist Entry Grade (118), Health & Malaria Inspector Gr II (43), Radiographer X-Ray Technician (25), Lab Assistant Gr. II (31), ECG Technician (4), Optometrist (2), Dialysis Technician (1), and Audiologist & Speech Therapist (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for online application submission is 14.10.2026 (23:59 hrs); the last date for fee payment is 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RRB CEN 05/2026 posts?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post, ranging from 18–33 years to 20–40 years as on 01.01.2027, with relaxations up to 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for general candidates (₹400 refundable) and ₹250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwBD/Female/Transgender/Minorities/EBC candidates (fully refundable), on appearing in the CBT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for RRB CEN 05/2026 posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, ranging from 12th pass with a paramedical diploma (Lab Assistant, ECG Technician) to a Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Pharmacy, Audiology, or Optometry, along with relevant registration where required. Full post-wise details are in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Single Stage Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 questions/100 marks with negative marking, followed by Document Verification and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for RRB Paramedical posts under CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Initial pay ranges from ₹21,700 (Lab Assistant Gr. II, Level 3) to ₹44,900 (Nursing Superintendent, Level 7), as per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for RRB CEN 05/2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must create an account on the unified RRB website (rrb.indianrailways.gov.in), select one RRB, fill the application with post/zone preferences, capture a live photo, upload documents, pay the fee, and submit before 14.10.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the RRB CEN 05/2026 CBT?
faq.answer: Yes, there is negative marking of 1/3 mark deducted for every wrong answer in the CBT.
